description: Controlled vocabulary of the 145 unique CWEs present in the locked 500-CVE dataset, used as the fixed target space for scoring LLM vulnerability-type extraction. Two levels: leaf CWE (strict) and author-defined coarse category (lenient).
grouping_scheme: MITRE CWE-1000 Research Concepts view (top-level pillar). Replaces the earlier author-defined coarse categories, which are retained for reference only in _deprecated_author_categories_note at end of file.
grouping_provenance: CWE-1000 pillar assignments derived from MITRE Research Concepts hierarchy; verify against cwe.mitre.org before final submission.
